[SWS_SM_00646] is considered by
State Management
as "active
update session".
⌋
As soon as
State Management
allows updating, it is necessary that
State Man-
agement
denies any further request for a new update session. To assure a higher
consistency in the
AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform
, multiple update sessions at a
time shall be not allowed.
For the
StateMachine
approach a separate interface
UpdateAllowed
is provided
to check if an update is allowed or not. This interface was introduced, because the lim-
ited logic of the
StateMachine
is not able to decide if an update is allowed. Therefore
this decision is delegated to a customer specific application e.g.
SMControlAppli-
cation
.
